Name: Bus Recolor
Author: gonzoen
Description:
Tired of the "Old 80's caravan" look of the bus? Now you can change it to something a little bit more modern, but still fitting in with the style of Stardew Valley.

Install:
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].

[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

[*]Run the game using SMAPI.

[/list]

Manifest.Name: Bus Recolor
Manifest.Description: Simple bus recolor to something a bit more modern.
